text: パソコン　つこて　くれとる？

structure.en: have you been using it for me?

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くれる says someone does it as a favor to the speaker; つこて is Kansai dialect for つかって. つこて くれとる = 'are using it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is the Kansai dialect form of ている, for something that keeps going on. くれとる = 'have been doing it for me'.
